notes: This is the pre-thesis provenance snapshot for the SPGI /thesis build, dated the day of the prescreen refresh and build (2026-07-18), NOT tied to a reported quarter — SPGI's next actual print is Q2 FY2026 on 2026-07-28, which is also the call where management is expected to issue the first full 2026 GAAP + adjusted guidance that formally excludes Mobility (spun off 2026-07-01 as MBGL). Everything dated after that call should be treated as the real Q2 FY2026 touch, with this file staying as the historical record of what was knowable before it. Regime note: stock fell ~17% in a single session on 2026-02-10 when FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance ($19.40-19.65, combined-company) missed the ~$19.96 consensus — a real earnings-guidance disappointment, not sentiment alone. It fell further into a February trough near $390 (forward P/E ~18-19x, the bear-case multiple anchor) before recovering through H1 2026, then popped on the 2026-07-01 Mobility spinoff completion (a real narrative simplification: shed the lower-margin, more cyclical Mobility unit, leaving a cleaner four-segment toll-booth business) before settling near $450. A distinct pull-forward flag surfaced on the Q1 FY2026 call (2026-04-28): management said some of the Ratings-division issuance strength was 'front-end loading of hyperscaler issuance relative to initial expectations,' and separately guided Ratings revenue growth to decelerate through 2026 and turn NEGATIVE in Q4 FY2026 as they lap prior-year highs. This is a real, disclosed, company-sourced pull-forward signal, not speculation, and is the single most important thing to track.
